description: This file contains unit tests for static activation rebalancing in an Orleans-based distributed system. It verifies the behavior of activations moving between silos during rebalancing without adding new activations.

classes.name: StaticRebalancingTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying static activation rebalancing in Orleans, inheriting from RebalancingTestBase and using the RebalancerFixture.

methods.name: Should_Move_Activations_From_Silo1_And_Silo3_To_Silo2_And_Silo4
methods.description: An asynchronous test method that initiates activation addition, waits for rebalancing, and asserts that activations have shifted as expected among silos.
